correctness.rationale: The projection-body support h(u)=kappa_(d-1)+2t*kappa_(d-2)*sqrt(1-(u.e_d)^2) identifies Pi K as an axial ball plus transverse disk. Axial section integration gives a degree-(d-1) Bernstein polynomial after volume normalization. Exact ratios u_(j+1)/u_j and strict log-convexity of I_m imply u_0=u_1<u_2<...<u_(d-1) for d>=3. Its Bernstein derivative is positive for any interior y>0; endpoint ball and cylinder limits and affine invariance follow. Independently recomputed coefficient order in d=3..11, with d=3 lower value 3pi^2/4 and upper 8. Finite dimensions corroborate the general Cauchy–Schwarz proof.
